title: Bytecode machine: small programs for each group of instructions, run on the bytecode engine

tests.name: bc01_arithmetic
tests.title: every arithmetic instruction on integers and reals, the sign and the precedence

tests.name: bc02_compare_logic
tests.title: comparison instructions, not, and, or, and the short circuit

tests.name: bc03_loops
tests.title: forprep and forloop over ranges, while with jumps, nested loops

tests.name: bc04_calls
tests.title: callf and ret: parameters, results, recursion and calls inside expressions

tests.name: bc05_lists
tests.title: new_list, list_push, list_index, list_set, length, negative index

tests.name: bc06_maps
tests.title: new_map, map_set, map_get and the length of a map

tests.name: bc07_strings
tests.title: strings: concatenation, interpolation, length, comparison, write and print

tests.name: bc08_augment
tests.title: augment: compound assignment on numbers, strings and lists

tests.name: bc09_coerce
tests.title: coerce and setlike: a declared type converts the value it receives

tests.name: bc10_expect_failure
tests.title: expect raises an error with the exit code 2 and the machine stops

tests.name: bc11_errors
tests.title: a run-time error (division by zero, an index out of range) is the same error on the machine

tests.name: bc12_bridge
tests.title: a loop over a list literal runs natively: iterprep and iterloop

tests.name: bc13_class_fallback
tests.title: a script with a class or a lambda is not translated yet (the emitter says so): it runs entirely on the tree walker with the same result (TD-46)

tests.name: bc14_recover
tests.title: recover, retry, resume and finalize of the process main run with the bytecode body

tests.name: bc15_retry
tests.title: retry runs the failing statement again with the variables the recover block changed

tests.name: bc16_collections
tests.title: lists, maps and sets: literals, index and store, push, loops over each kind, empty collections

tests.name: bc17_interpolation
tests.title: interpolation with names, expressions inside the braces and several parts

tests.name: bc18_shared_names
tests.title: constants and variables of the aspect, a class and a destructor are reached by name; the safe points free in the same order

tests.name: bridge
tests.title: what the emitter does not translate runs on the tree walker (TD-46)

tests.name: loop_call
tests.title: a loop that calls a function
